article.title: Promotion of educational and economic interests of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and other weaker sections
article.content: The State shall promote with special care the educational and economic interests of the weaker sections of the people, and, in particular, of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes, and shall protect them from social injustice and all forms of exploitation.
article.html:
46Promotion of educational and economic interests of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and other weaker sections

Article 46 · Part IV

The State shall promote with special care the educational and economic interests of the weaker sections of the people, and, in particular, of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes, and shall protect them from social injustice and all forms of exploitation.
